ritika: Quick run of quant profiles across regions and GPUs for r-llama-13b bring-up. Baseline = fp16. TL;DR: fp8 gives ~1.7-1.9x throughput w/ small quality hit (~0.3-0.8%), int8 gives the biggest speedups (2.4-3.0x) but has nontrivial QA deltas on long-form / math prompts (~1.5-2.5%). H100 favors int8 more; A100 gains are smaller. Results and snippets below.

benchbot: AUTO-BENCH: summary attached (csv). Tests: seq=512, batch=8, prefix-cache enabled for hot-path. kernels=auto (flash_attn when available). Regions: us-west1 (GCP-a100), eu-west1 (gcp-h100), onprem-equinix (a100-p4d).

sam: nice, can you paste the compact table?

ritika: sure — compact CSV:
```
model,hw,region,precision,p95_ms,tokens_per_sec,quality_delta_pct
r-llama-13b,h100,eu-west1,fp16,42,480,0.0
r-llama-13b,h100,eu-west1,fp8,33,820,-0.6
r-llama-13b,h100,eu-west1,int8,29,1400,-1.9
r-llama-13b,a100,us-west1,fp16,58,350,0.0
r-llama-13b,a100,us-west1,fp8,44,620,-0.8
r-llama-13b,a100,us-west1,int8,40,840,-2.4
r-llama-13b,t4,asia-east1,fp16,160,60,0.0
```

cheng: interesting that h100 int8 is that much faster — what kernels were we on for int8? flash_attn + triton matmul?

ritika: for H100 int8 we ended up on fused-fp8/int8 path with the new cuda kernels (flash_attn v2 fallback for attention, triton matmul for int8 blocks). For A100 int8 we hit some slower tiled paths — less optimized integer matmul and higher p95. We flagged a missing kernel variant for a100 sm80 that could shave ~8-12% latency.

dave: any quality breakdown by eval set? LM perplexity vs MMLU-ish accuracy?

ritika: quick breakdown: on our proprietary longform-eval (completion coherence + factuality) fp8 gives mean drop ~0.5% (mostly stylistic), int8 gives ~1.8% on average but up to 2.4% on multi-step reasoning subtask. On MMLU-style microbench, int8 drop was smaller ~0.9%. So degradation is workload-dependent.

olga: operational note — cache miss rate goes up ~3% under int8 on H100 due to different tiling. We saw more KV-cache churn at higher concurrency. That influenced p95.

sam: recommended profiles and routing? what should we push into canary?

ritika: recommendation:
- low-latency routes (interactive chat): use fp8-latency profile (fp8, micro-batching, prefix-cache aggressive).
- background batch / high-throughput routes: int8-fast on H100 only (pin to eu-west1 h100 pools), but mark eval/regression gating required.
- A100: prefer fp8 as sweet spot; int8 only if customer tolerates ~2% quality drop and we enable fallback to fp16 for regression hits.

benchbot: quick config snippet to reproduce: 
```bash
./bench --model r-llama-13b --seq 512 --batch 8 --precision int8 --kernels auto --cache-prefix true --region eu-west1 --device h100
```

cheng: I'll try adding the sm80 int8 kernel and re-run A100 plate next week. If sm80 patch works we might push int8 for a100 with ~+20% throughput.

olga: can we add a perf flag in rollout so we can split traffic by qprofile? e.g., route=fp8-latency vs int8-fast. I want observability per-profile.

ritika: yes — console support already supports per-model & per-profile metrics. I'll add dashboard tiles: p95, tok/sec, quality_regressions per qprofile and a synthetic prompt set.
